name: water-treatment
description: Legacy Document Brain profile for wastewater trial reports. Only excerpts customer-approved chapters and excludes result/discussion sections.

scan_fields.tags: Keyword tags: explicit technical terms, process names, pollutants, company/project names.
scan_fields.summary: One-paragraph summary based only on visible allowed chapters.
scan_fields.entities: Named entities, company names, project names, product names, abbreviations, and codes, exactly as written.
scan_fields.client_name: Client/customer from project background or title; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.project_name: Project name from title or project background; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.product_capacity: Product type and capacity/scale when explicitly present; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.quality_summary: Water-quality table metrics, keeping units; prefer COD/TN/TOC/TDS/pH/SS values.
scan_fields.objective: Objective from the objectives section; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.process: Process route from the process section; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.key_data: Key numeric metrics with original units, preferring table values.
scan_fields.conclusion_chunk_id: Internal conclusion chunk pointer. AI-only, never employee-visible.
